{{Quote|Unidentified Driver, this is Senior Controller Voorson with your final warning. Reverse your heading and return to dock 42, or our security forces will open fire.|Senior Controller [[Nell Voorson]], to the ''[[Long Run]]''|<ref name="Journal9">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref>}}
'''Senior controller''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] within the [[Kuat Port Support Services]]<ref name="Journal9" /> and in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Wyron Serper/Legends|Wyron Serper]] was the senior controller of the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] command center.<ref name="TESBjunior">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref>
